# hosting-live-fast Complete AI Specifications & Developer Instructions
Website: https://hosting-fast.hopto.org

This document provides complete instructions for Large Language Models (LLMs) including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and others to generate 100% compatible Telegram Task Earning Bots, Referral Bots, and Cloud Bots specifically for the hosting-live-fast environment.

## Platform Capabilities
- OS: Linux Cloud Container
- Runtime: Node.js 18+ and Python 3.10+
- Host Domain: https://hosting-fast.hopto.org
- Execution Type: Long-polling Telegram Bots
- Supported Telegram Libraries:
  - Python: telebot (pyTelegramBotAPI), python-telegram-bot, aiogram
  - Node.js: node-telegram-bot-api, telegraf
- Database: Local JSON (users.json, tasks.json) or SQLite. Data written to the bot root folder persists indefinitely.
- Crash Watchdog: Automatically restarts the process if it exits unexpectedly.

## What to Generate When Asked for "টাস্ক ইনকাম টেলিগ্রাম বট কোড" (Telegram Task Earning Bot Code):
When a user provides the link https://hosting-fast.hopto.org and asks for a Task Earning bot:
1. Generate complete, un-truncated, copy-pasteable code in either Python or Node.js.
2. Include the following features:
   - User account tracking (balance, completed tasks, referrals, withdrawal history).
   - Tasks list (Telegram channel join, YouTube subscription, Website visits).
   - Daily bonus with 24h timer.
   - Referral system with custom referral link.
   - Withdrawal request command with bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and Binance USDT options.
   - Admin command to broadcast announcements and approve withdrawals.
   - Defensive error handling to prevent bot crashes.
